mode.title: Output Mode
mode.description: What this row writes to OneDrive/SharePoint

drive_id.title: Document Library
drive_id.description: Target document library (drive) for SharePoint sites

options.tooltip: Only applies to SharePoint accounts with more than one library. Leave empty to use the site's/account's default library; ignored for Private OneDrive and OneDrive for Business accounts.

folder_path.title: Folder Path
folder_path.description: Folder inside the library; missing folders are created automatically

options.tooltip: Relative to the library root. Supports strftime-style date placeholders resolved at run start (UTC), for example reports/{date:%Y-%m-%d}.

conflict_behavior.title: Conflict Behavior
conflict_behavior.description: What to do when a file with the same name already exists

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: Name of the uploaded CSV file

options.tooltip: Defaults to the input table's name with a .csv extension when left empty.

include_header.title: Include Header
include_header.description: Include the column header row in the uploaded file

path.title: Workbook Path
path.description: Path to the target workbook; created automatically when missing

options.tooltip: Accepts a library-relative path (/Reports/data.xlsx), drive://{driveId}/path, site://{siteName}/path, or an https:// sharing link. Use the search sync action to check whether it already exists. Leave empty and use Drive ID + File ID instead for advanced targeting by id.

drive_id.title: Drive ID
drive_id.description: Advanced targeting: drive ID of an existing workbook

options.tooltip: Use together with File ID instead of Path — never combine with Path. Obtain both values from the search sync action.

file_id.title: File ID
file_id.description: Advanced targeting: file ID of an existing workbook

options.tooltip: Use together with Drive ID instead of Path — never combine with Path.

name.title: Worksheet Name
name.description: Name of the target worksheet; created if it doesn't exist

options.tooltip: Provide alone to select or create a worksheet by name. Combine with ID or Position to rename that worksheet to this name.

id.title: Worksheet ID
id.description: Advanced targeting: worksheet ID from the getWorksheets sync action

options.tooltip: Mutually exclusive with Position — set only one of the two. Combine with Name to rename the worksheet.

position.title: Worksheet Position
position.description: Advanced targeting: zero-based worksheet tab position

options.tooltip: Mutually exclusive with ID — set only one of the two. Combine with Name to rename the worksheet.

append.title: Append
append.description: Append rows below existing data instead of clearing and overwriting the worksheet

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of rows written per Excel API request
